architecture_limits: shared attention retains its content-addressing and quadratic-length cost
finite-grid regenerative adapter is not the global continuous He-Xiong closed-form solution
content matrix isolates dynamics; it is separate from the mechanism core/controller 2x2
old AV heldout cohort is not fresh external confirmation
capacity_limit: analytic and two_gate adapters have different total parameter counts; report them
common_capacity: identical trainable causal SDPA, encoder and readout; common checkpoint bound by exact SHA

content_contract.async_av: previously observed 48 CREMA-D clips, actor split 4/2/2, 24/12/12 clips; six emotions
content_contract.binding: same-actor matched vs deranged AV pairs, balanced each modality, fixed 1.5s deadline and .1s clock
content_contract.copy: input-only causal selected/query prefix counts and ordinal addresses, common to all arms
content_contract.frontend: fixed log-mel/DCT; common downstream encoder trained here, not a foundation encoder
content_contract.mqar: four queried early key/value bindings; original input and counterfactual query/gold permutation
content_contract.observation_cost: window compression still consumes all original observations, no sensor saving claim
content_contract.timestamps: causal physical time; no full-duration normalized grid

economics.acceptance: quality noninferior and lower actual relevant execution cost required jointly
economics.budgets: 256 optimizer updates and 20 CPU seconds are separate experiments
economics.complete_worker: imports, preparation, training, selection, inference and evidence serialization via wait4
economics.cpu_budget: loop includes scheduled validation, can overshoot by one batch/validation; report actual
economics.deployment_limits: no incremental cache benchmark, raw-media decoding, live sensor, network or device energy measurement
economics.inference: prepared features to logits, whole-sequence batch1 validation profile and batch evaluation throughput
economics.shared_pretraining: bill once per task/seed; do not duplicate in the total study ledger

matrix: 4 tasks x 3 seeds x (one common pretraining + 2 cores x 2 content modes x 2 budgets) = 108 jobs

quality.all_conditions: report every predeclared condition, not only positive strata
quality.critical_content_floor: 99% exact recall on copy/MQAR ID; report 64/128-length OOD separately
quality.primary_content_contrast: analytic minus two_gate within same task/seed/mode/budget/condition
quality.uncertainty: seed/episode paired bootstrap, descriptive; AV only two heldout actors, no general significance claim

selection.heldout: all test and diagnostics after selection; no post-test hyperparameter changes
selection.rule: minimum validation CE, first tie, including initialization at step zero
selection.step_zero: report donor_selected_step and donor_trained; zero cannot be called a trained content encoder
